description: FateCat CalculationJob durable runtime backend registry。这里登记 memory、sqlite 与 external backend 候选，明确生产边界和迁移路径；不保存真实 DSN、凭证或生产连接结果。

decision.firstAdapterPath: Postgres ReportJobStore adapter with transactional claim/release, migration/job live smoke, outbox worker lease negative smoke and job execution worker lease primitive smoke
decision.nextTask: 0074 adds Postgres job execution worker lease primitive smoke; next task must prove crash/restart external backend worker or external webhook/Vault live evidence

backends.name: In-process memory report job store
backends.privacyBoundary: Memory backend must not persist user input, report body, webhook secret, token or DSN after process lifetime.

migration.upgradePath: Use sqlite for local restart recovery; use postgres candidate for production external backend.
migration.rollbackPath: Set FATE_REPORT_JOB_STORE=memory for local development only.

metadata.rationale: Fast local default with zero external dependency.
metadata.failureMode: Process restart loses job state, idempotency, event history and outbox records.
metadata.releaseImpact: Not eligible for public production durable runtime.
metadata.risk: Using memory backend in production would lose running job state on restart.

backends.name: SQLite local persistent report job store
backends.coordination: single replica sqlite transaction and local webhook outbox lease

config.secretPolicy: callback URL/secret may be stored only through Fernet encrypted config vault when FATE_WEBHOOK_CONFIG_FERNET_KEYS is configured

backends.privacyBoundary: Public API must not expose SQLite file path, callback URL, webhook secret, lease owner, report body, user name or non-Beijing real location.

migration.upgradePath: Keep sqlite as local baseline; introduce postgres adapter for external database backed production runtime.
migration.rollbackPath: Return to memory only for local development; keep sqlite migration optional and backward compatible.

metadata.rationale: Provides local restart recovery, replayable payload recovery, event history and webhook outbox baselines without new infrastructure dependency.
metadata.failureMode: Multiple production replicas cannot safely share local SQLite as a distributed job system.
metadata.releaseImpact: Allowed for local and single-replica smoke only; not enough for public multi-replica production.
metadata.risk: SQLite local lease can reduce duplicate local redelivery but is not a production distributed worker lease.

backends.name: Postgres external report job store candidate
backends.durability: external relational database durability after live migration/job smoke
backends.coordination: transactional webhook outbox and job execution row claim/release smoke baseline using conditional update

config.secretPolicy: database URL must come from secret manager or environment; registry and logs must never store the DSN value

requiredEvidence: live adapter smoke: bash scripts/postgres-job-store-live-smoke.sh against disposable external database
outbox worker lease negative smoke: bash scripts/postgres-worker-lease-smoke.sh against disposable external database
job execution worker lease primitive smoke: bash scripts/postgres-job-worker-lease-smoke.sh against disposable external database
future crash/restart external backend worker smoke with two workers
externalVerification: FATE_REPORT_JOB_POSTGRES_LIVE_EVIDENCE must point to passed fatecat.postgres_job_store_live_smoke JSON before postgres production readiness can pass
backends.privacyBoundary: Postgres registry may name env vars and migration evidence, but must not include DSN, username, password, report body, callback URL or user input.

migration.upgradePath: Use PostgresReportJobStore behind FATE_REPORT_JOB_STORE=postgres; keep passed postgres live smoke, outbox worker lease negative smoke and job execution worker lease primitive smoke evidence, then prove crash/restart external backend worker before production eligibility can advance.
migration.rollbackPath: Switch back to sqlite for local single-replica baseline if external database smoke fails.

metadata.rationale: Postgres is the first external backend candidate because it can hold job state, event history, idempotency, outbox and worker claim state in one transactional source of truth.
metadata.failureMode: Without real database DSN, psycopg and migration/job smoke, selecting FATE_REPORT_JOB_STORE=postgres must fail instead of silently falling back.
metadata.releaseImpact: Blocks production multi-replica durable runtime until crash/restart external backend worker, public webhook and external secret lifecycle evidence exist.
metadata.risk: External database operations require live migration, connection pooling, secret handling, lock contention and rollback evidence.

backends.name: Temporal workflow orchestrator future candidate
backends.durability: durable workflow event history after integration
backends.coordination: workflow task queue and retry policy after integration

config.secretPolicy: Temporal endpoint and credentials must come from secret manager or environment; no values in registry

externalVerification: future: Temporal namespace connectivity and workflow replay smoke
backends.privacyBoundary: Workflow history must not store raw report markdown, webhook secret or unnecessary user input.

migration.upgradePath: Use Temporal when report generation becomes multi-step workflow orchestration rather than a single job store adapter concern.
migration.rollbackPath: Keep ReportJobStore backend independent so Temporal can be disabled without losing API contract.

metadata.rationale: Temporal is better suited for long-lived multi-step workflows, not the first minimal external ReportJobStore adapter.
metadata.failureMode: Using Temporal as a label without worker, namespace, replay and retry evidence would overstate durable execution.
metadata.risk: Adds operational dependency and workflow modeling cost; should not be introduced before Postgres adapter contract is proven insufficient.

backends.name: Redis queue auxiliary candidate
backends.durability: queue durability only; not job source of truth

config.secretPolicy: Redis URL must not be stored in contracts or logs

requiredEvidence: future queue auxiliary ADR if introduced
future queue plus database source-of-truth smoke
externalVerification: future: Redis connectivity only if used as auxiliary queue
backends.privacyBoundary: Redis queue payload must not contain raw markdown, webhook secret or unnecessary user input.

migration.upgradePath: Use only as a wake-up or dispatch queue paired with Postgres/other durable source of truth.
migration.rollbackPath: Disable Redis queue without losing CalculationJob source-of-truth state.

metadata.rationale: Redis can be useful for dispatch, but should not be the durable CalculationJob record source.
metadata.failureMode: Treating a queue as source of truth can lose audit history, idempotency and recovery evidence.
metadata.releaseImpact: Not selected for durable runtime source of truth.
metadata.risk: Without database-backed state, retries and duplicate delivery can become hard to audit.

invariants: RuntimeBackend registry 不保存真实 DSN、token、secret、webhook URL、用户输入、报告正文或生产日志。
memory/sqlite available 只代表本地 baseline，不代表 external backend 已生产。

backend.postgres 是首个 external backend adapter candidate；job worker lease smoke baseline 可证明 schema/job/outbox/config 真实数据库路径、webhook outbox duplicate claim negative path 和 job execution lease primitive，但 status=planned，直到 crash/restart external backend worker、外部 Vault/KMS 和公网 webhook 证据完成。
backend.temporal 是 future workflow orchestrator，不是当前 ReportJobStore adapter。
backend.redis_queue 不得作为 CalculationJob source of truth。
任何 production multi-replica durable runtime 结论必须来自外部 backend adapter、迁移 smoke、crash/restart smoke 和 duplicate claim negative test。
